column1: # F-006: Open XML SDK findings judged, each with its reason. Read by validate.py.
# A finding listed here does not fail a run; one not listed does. A row no run sees is
# printed as a note, so a stale row shows. Run with --no-known to see everything.
# Columns, tab-separated: deck glob, rule id (or refused:<exception>), part glob,
#   sdk-vs-ecma      The SDK, which follows Office, rejects what ECMA-376 5th edition
#                    allows and F4 accepts. A false positive against the standard; whether
#                    PowerPoint accepts it is unverified until PV-01, so it is not dismissed.
#   fixture-invalid  The fixture is invalid on purpose or by construction, and F4 agrees.
#   packaging        System.IO.Packaging refuses a package the engine admits under
#                    ECMA-376 Part 2. Whether PowerPoint opens it is unverified (PV-01).
# Found 2026-11-07 against DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.5.1, validating as Microsoft365.

column6: anchor="just" and anchor="dist" are in ST_TextAnchoringType in ECMA-376; the SDK's enumeration rejects them, and none of the 66 real decks writes them. Kept apart from area-text so that deck passes both validators (F4-02)

buSzPct val="100%": a percent string, ST_TextBulletSizePercent in ECMA-376 5th ed., which F4 accepts; the SDK takes Int32. PowerPoint writes the numeric form, which both accept (tools/f4/allowances.tsv F4A-1)
serverZoom="80%": ST_Percentage in ECMA-376 5th ed. is a percent string; the SDK takes Int32
serverZoom as a percent string; as rich-properties
restoredLeft sz as a percent string, legal in ECMA-376 5th ed.; the SDK takes Int32
x:unknown="kept" in a namespace no schema knows, kept to test retention of unknown attributes; F4 rejects it too
p:smartTags is a child of CT_Presentation in ECMA-376; the SDK's schema has no such child
htmlPubPr target and title are declared in ECMA-376; the SDK's schema lacks them
an empty p:ext: CT_Extension's content is an xsd:any F4 accepts as empty; the SDK requires one element
notesMaster with no cSld, written by the generator; F4 rejects it too. The fixture tests properties, not masters
handoutMaster with no cSld; as notesMaster
vt:array: ECMA-376's vendored schema names the attributes lBounds and uBounds, the SDK lBound and uBound. Which PowerPoint writes is open; a real deck with an array property settles it
the same lBounds against lBound conflict, from the other side
a relationship target differing in case from its ZIP item; OPC part names are case-insensitive and the engine resolves it
ZIP items named in percent-encoded form, targets unencoded; ECMA-376 Part 2 makes them one part (OPC-01)
ZIP item names with a raw space and a non-ASCII letter, targets percent-encoded; equivalent under ECMA-376 Part 2 (OPC-01)
bwMode on p:graphicFrame is declared in CT_GraphicalObjectFrame in ECMA-376; the SDK does not declare it there. The deck exercises every root child of a shape tree (T1D)

mc:MustUnderstand naming the PresentationML namespace, which F4 and the engine understand; the SDK says it does not understand it. Until 2026-11-07 this exception crashed the runner, which any deck with mc:MustUnderstand could do. It is now a refusal (SPEC-08)
A relationships part under a percent-encoded ZIP item name; equivalent under ECMA-376 Part 2 (PKG-02)
